title: Kontsevich-Zagier conjecture for Hensel-minimal fields with sections
summary: We generalise Yin's motivic integration with section to the Hensel-minimal framework, with and without volume forms, building on Stout and Vermeulen's work on a Hrushovski-Kazhdan style motivic integral for $1$-h-minimal valued fields. In particular, we get a bijective motivic integral \emph{à la} Hrushovski-Kazhdan between certain Grothendieck groups of definable sets on the valued field and the coarse Grothendieck groups on $\mathrm{RV}$ in the Denef-Pas language, with angular component.
